brand-banner-matt.alt: OPUDA'S PAINT advertising banner: the wordmark above a red brush stroke and a finished two-storey house, with the Matt product name and the 5-year guarantee seal.

brand-banner-red.alt: OPUDA'S PAINT advertising artwork showing a brush lifting red paint from an open tin beside the OPUDA'S wordmark and the 5-year guarantee seal.

product-matt-bucket.alt: A white 20-litre pail of OPUDA'S MATT paint resting on a second pail against a cream panelled wall. The label reads 'High quality, for walls and ceilings, smooth finish, better flow, extra coverage, anti-fungi additive, eco-friendly, weather resistance' and carries the phone number 0902 642 4350.

product-matt-pail.alt: A pail of OPUDA'S MATT paint with the full label visible, showing the house-and-brush logo, the red brush stroke and the 5-year guarantee seal.

product-silk-bucket.alt: A pail of OPUDA'S SILK paint on a wooden platform, with a paint-covered roller behind it on an interior site.

product-silk-pail.alt: A close view of the OPUDA'S SILK pail, showing the white label, four-colour paint dots and the red brush stroke.

project-finished-villa.alt: A completed two-storey house finished in warm off-white with grey pilasters, dark roof tiles, an arched entrance revealing a chandelier, and brick-edged boundary pillars in front.

project-arched-facade.alt: The front elevation of a two-storey house finished in pale cream, with stone-clad piers, an arched balcony and scaffolding still in place.

project-porch-blue.alt: A finished blue-grey house under a tall white porch column, with a painter working on a mobile scaffold in the foreground.

project-cream-scaffold.alt: A cream-finished house elevation seen through bamboo scaffolding, with a painter applying the final coat around a window.

project-corner-scaffold.alt: A corner view of a house under construction, its cream topcoat applied above grey render, with scaffolding wrapping the facade.

project-dark-roof.alt: A large house with a steep charcoal roof, stone-clad columns and freshly painted cream walls, photographed before the scaffolding was struck.

project-stone-brick.alt: A boundary wall in progress: rusticated terracotta block piers, grey render panels, white capping and a white string course.

project-blue-fence.alt: A finished white and grey facade behind a turquoise spike fence and rendered boundary wall with brick piers.

project-render-stage.alt: A house at render stage: bare grey screeded walls, white fascia bands, a dark roof and scaffolding across two elevations.

project-painter.alt: A painter on scaffolding applying paint to a cream wall beside a window with patterned stone cladding.

project-stone-wall.alt: A stone-clad boundary wall with white capping and a row of palms, painted in white and rusticated brick.

project-gate.alt: A pair of black steel gates with gold detailing, set between rusticated brick piers capped in white.

interior-lilac-lounge.alt: An interior lounge painted in lilac above and below the picture rail, with a deeper plum feature wall, a peach corridor beyond and terrazzo-look tiled floor.

interior-mauve-peach.alt: An empty interior room with a mauve wall, a peach recessed alcove and warm pepper tones on the adjoining wall, before furnishing.

render-modern-white.alt: An architectural render of a modern white house with dark vertical fins, timber cladding and a glass balcony.

render-modern-grey.alt: An architectural render of a contemporary house in white and charcoal with timber screens and a paved forecourt.

project-brick-gate.alt: A boundary gate with red stone-effect brick piers capped in white, a black wrought-iron double gate with scrollwork, and a car parked in the driveway beyond.

project-stone-pier.alt: A close view of a red stone-effect brick pier beside a plain grey rendered panel, both capped in white, with a palm tree in front.

project-mauve-finished.alt: A finished two-storey house in white above a dusty mauve ground floor, with a brick-effect pier, charcoal roof tiles and a car in the driveway.

project-mauve-scaffold.alt: A house elevation still on scaffolding, white above a mauve ground-floor band, with a painter working the upper storey by hand.

project-mauve-balcony.alt: A close view of a house entrance bay with a curved balcony soffit over a mauve wall, a worker reaching up beside a stepladder.

interior-gallery-stair.alt: A stairwell with plain white walls hung with framed paintings, a glass balustrade and dark tiled steps, the handrail wrapped for protection.

interior-gallery-hall.alt: A narrow hallway in white with a dark floor strip, lined on both sides with framed artwork leading to a window at the far end.

project-commercial-cladding.alt: A multi-storey commercial building under construction, faced in grey and white composite cladding panels with bamboo scaffold still up.

project-grey-stone-gate.alt: A bungalow with a tiled gable and portico columns, seen behind a boundary wall cast in a grey stone-block pattern with dark bronze-effect piers and an arched iron gate.

project-cream-render-scaffold.alt: A cream-rendered house elevation on bamboo scaffold, with a stone-tile accent panel being fitted beneath the windows under a finished charcoal roof.

project-grey-duplex.alt: A contemporary grey duplex with white string-course banding, a dark feature panel at first floor and electric-fence wire along the parapet.

project-grey-duplex-wall.alt: A grey and white banded boundary wall matching a duplex behind it, with a run of young planting set into the base of the wall.

project-grey-stone-pier.alt: A stretch of boundary wall in the same grey stone-block pattern and dark pier finish as the gate, with aggregate still stacked beside it.

interior-pastel-door.alt: A pale-yellow room with raised panel moulding and a marble floor, a black-framed glazed door hung on a barn-door track and a ceiling-mounted camera.

interior-pastel-marble.alt: A pale-yellow open-plan room with a marble floor still under plastic sheeting and flooring off-cuts stacked against the wall.

project-arched-bungalow.alt: A cream bungalow with a taupe plinth band, a hipped roof and a triple-arched white portico on fluted columns, with two unglazed window frames resting on the ground beside it.

project-teal-duplex-courtyard.alt: A paved rear courtyard with white stone urns on a terrace, a ladder against an outbuilding roof and a row of garage doors across a white boundary wall.

project-teal-duplex-urn.alt: A close view of a white stone-effect urn planter on a grey pedestal, set into a stone-clad wall base beside dark-tinted windows.

project-teal-duplex-entrance.alt: The entrance of a contemporary duplex in white and charcoal with a teal band at first floor, a glazed balcony balustrade and white urns flanking the steps.

project-mauve-wall-dog.alt: A wide view of a pink-walled boundary with white piers and a scrollwork gate, a dog visible through the railing and a painter working on scaffold above.

interior-pastel-early.alt: A pale-yellow room with a white ceiling cove and a bare marble floor, a trestle standing in the middle of the room before the skirting was fitted.

project-commercial-aircon.alt: A multi-storey commercial building finished in grey render with white window surrounds, blue-tinted glazing, external air-conditioning units and bamboo scaffold on one corner.

project-portico-event.alt: A grand white portico on round columns over a powder-blue ground floor, with balloon bunting along the balcony and a painter finishing the porch ceiling from a scaffold tower.

project-dormer-elevation.alt: A pale cream house with a multi-gabled dark roof, a dormer window and a vertical stone-tile accent pier beside an arched, stone-surrounded doorway.

project-mauve-gate-dusk.alt: A pink and white two-storey house photographed at dusk, scaffold still up on the first floor with the ground floor and gate already finished.

project-dormer-elevation-side.alt: A side elevation of a pale cream house with the same multi-gabled dark roof and stone-tile pier, building sand still on the ground and a matching tower under construction next door.

project-teal-duplex-render.alt: Two workers rendering the white entrance bay of a duplex beside a charcoal pier, with bagged building sand on the ground and stone urns already in place.
